pin.title: Server Rules
pin.description: Welcome! For the comfort and safety of everyone, please read and follow all the rules listed below.

fields.name: General Rules
fields.value:
> **1. Be Respectful:** Maintain proper etiquette and respect all members.
> **2. No Spam:** Spamming chat, emojis, or unnecessary mentions is prohibited.
> **3. No NSFW:** Adult content in any form is not allowed.
> **4. Stay On Topic:** Use channels according to their intended purpose.

fields.name: Transaction Rules
fields.value:
> **1. Order via Channel:** All orders must be placed through #┃order channel.
> **2. No Hit & Run:** Canceling orders unilaterally after the process has started is prohibited.
> **3. Full Payment:** Complete payment as per invoice before order processing.
> **4. Be Patient:** Order processing follows a queue, please be patient.

fields.name: Communication Rules
fields.value:
> **1. No DM Staff:** Don't send DMs to staff unless permitted.
> **2. One Ticket/Thread:** Create only one ticket or thread per request.
> **3. No Promotion:** Advertising or promotion without permission is prohibited.

footer.text: Violations will result in sanctions. Thank you!

channels.name: ┃order
channels.topic: Create a new post to place an order.

pin.title: How to Place an Order
pin.description: Please create a **new post** in this channel to place an order. Use a clear title and follow the format below.

fields.name: Post Title Format
fields.value:
`[Service Type] - Your Project Name`
Example: `[Discord Bot] - Automated Store Bot`

fields.name: Post Content
fields.value:
Describe your requirements in detail within the post, including:
- **Desired features**
- **References (if any)**
- **Budget**
- **Deadline (if any)**

fields.name: ⏳ Process Flow
fields.value:
1. You create a post.
2. Staff will review and add **'In Progress'** tag.
3. Further discussion will be conducted in your post's thread.
4. Staff will send an invoice in #┃invoice.
5. Order will be processed.
